name: @oxy.so/services
description: OxyHQ Expo/React Native SDK — UI components, screens, and native features
author: OxyHQ

scripts.build: bun run check:icon-fonts && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target commonjs && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target module && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target typescript && bun run copy-assets && bun run copy-dts && bun run delete-dts.js && bun run delete-debug-view
scripts.build:js: bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target commonjs && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target module && bun run copy-assets

//@oxy.so/bloom: Bloom 23.0.0 is required: Services styles through React Native styles and Bloom's colour tokens (`createTokenStyles` from `@oxy.so/bloom/theme`) and passes no `className`, which Bloom 23 no longer takes; apps need no NativeWind for Services. First-party Bloom peers remain open above this minimum.
//@oxy.so/bloom-data: Required: OxyProvider opens each account's @oxy.so/bloom-data store from the session (one store per account, with the durable copy Services owns: a SQLite file on a device, an IndexedDB database on the web), and Services writes every person it reads into its User entity there, which apps' entities refer to. One instance per app, like Bloom; first-party, so the range is open.
//@react-native-async-storage/async-stor: Required, though Services itself reads it only for the one-time move off it (data/deviceStorage.ts: its device key-value data now lives in bloom-data, each key copied over the first time it is read, and its dead keys, among them the React Query caches 14.x kept, deleted once). @oxy.so/core and @oxy.so/protocol load it on a device for the device id, the identity marker and the crypto storage, and Expo autolinks only non-optional peers (docs/engineering/package-rules.md, Native peers; __tests__/packaging/requiredNativePeers.test.ts).
//@oxy.so/core: Core 7.46.0 supplies `OxyHostAccount.languages` (ADR 0058 R10), the account's languages a session host gives; 7.34.0 supplies `@oxy.so/core/host` (the session host contract, ADR 0058), `createUserEventSocket` and `session.sessionId`, which the provider's host mode is built on; 7.13.0 supplies the `usernamePolicy.*`, `actionErrors.*` and `signin.errors.{network,invalidInput,server}` strings every username field and failure toast is worded with; 7.9.1 fences ordinary authenticated HTTP requests across session changes during auth preflight, which organization claim and creation require; 7.9.0 supplies `deviceComparisonCode`, the short code `OxyDeviceSignIn` prints; 7.8.0 supplies the device sign-in request's `approvalUrl` and the `signin.device.*` strings `OxyDeviceSignIn` shows; 7.7.0 supplies the bounded native asset file adapter and phase progress installed by OxyProvider; 7.6.0 forwards guest locale and first-touch campaign metadata through signup; 7.3.0 supplies `users.lookupMany`, with which the account members screen fails (and retries) a profile read whose chunk failed instead of caching those members as handle-less; 7.2.0 supplies `assets.cachedUrl`, with which `useFileDownloadUrl` answers an already-resolved URL in its first render; 6.16.0 supplies `requireServerVerdict` and `onHolderRejected`, with which the cold boot checks a session it painted from the cache; 6.13.0 supplies the `accounts.settings.*` strings (picture, categories) the account settings speak in every language; 6.12.0 supplies `fileManagement.contentLost` and the `lost` file status a lost file is listed with; 6.11.0 supplies the `follow.errors.*` strings the follow error codes are worded with; 6.4.0 the `follow.*` strings the follow buttons read for every verb and language; 6.1.0 the `oxy.auth.email.{startChange,change,remove}` and `oxy.auth.password.remove` the sign-in & security panels call. Keep one Core instance per app; raise this floor with the root catalogue when new runtime APIs are required.
//react-native: Expo SDK 58, React Native 0.83 to 0.88 and React 19.2+. Bloom 23 needs react-native-reanimated 4.6 (React Native 0.83 to 0.87) and react-native-gesture-handler 3.3, and Expo SDK 58 is the first SDK that ships both (reanimated 4.7.1, gesture-handler 3.3), so it is the floor of every Expo module here; compat/expo-58 installs that stack as an external consumer and checks it on every CI run (`bun check.mjs`): every peer here admits it, services' published src typechecks against its types, <OxyProvider> mounts and settles its cold boot on iOS, web (react-native-web 0.21) and react-native-macos 0.83 with the native modules macOS lacks absent. React Native 0.83 stays admitted for Astro, Oxy's browser: react-native-macos 0.83 is its latest release and the oldest React Native Bloom 23's reanimated supports.
